name: Jinvia
description: Pure-C11, zero-dependency capability sandbox engine: JCB bytecode VM, C-subset compiler, and a minimal MCP stdio server for running untrusted plugins/AI tools.
sites_https_justification: All project URLs use https (GitHub, (no module registry)).
description_good_justification: README opens by stating what it is: a pure-C sandbox engine (JCB bytecode VM + C-subset compiler + MCP stdio server) for running untrusted capabilities/plugins safely. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/README.md.
interact_justification: Build/run: ./jinvia run examples/thermostat-guard (offline) and docs/INSTALL.md. Feedback: GitHub Issues and Discussions. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the per-commit gate, DCO sign-off, and red lines: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the required checks a change must pass (gcc/clang -Werror, ASan/UBSan, Valgrind, fuzzing, cppcheck) and the process: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: Apache-2.0 is an OSI-approved FLOSS license. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
documentation_basics_justification: Docs cover usage and architecture in README.md, SPEC.md, SPEC_JCB.md, docs/INSTALL.md and docs/mcp.md. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
documentation_interface_justification: README + docs/INSTALL.md show how to run the CLI and embed the engine (C API): https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md.
repo_public_justification: Public git repository on GitHub: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia
repo_track_justification: Git records every change with author and date. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
repo_interim_justification: Work is committed to main continuously, not only at release time. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
version_unique_justification: Releases use unique semantic versions; e.g. git tag v0.1.0 and the GitHub Release. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md plus per-version GitHub Releases describe each release. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has yet fixed a publicly known vulnerability with a CVE. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
report_process_justification: Bugs and requests are filed via GitHub Issues (templates configured): https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/issues
report_responses_justification: The maintainer responds to bug reports on the issue tracker on a best-effort basis (solo project). See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests get a response on the issue tracker on a best-effort basis. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
report_archive_justification: Issues and their discussion remain public and searchable: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/issues?q=is%3Aissue.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents the vulnerability reporting process and coordinated disclosure: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reporting via GitHub Security Advisories: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/security/advisories/new , or by email as stated in SECURITY.md (https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a report within 7 days. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
build_justification: `make` builds the CLI; `make lib` builds libjinvia.a/.so (verified in CI). See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/Makefile.
build_common_tools_justification: Standard C toolchain (gcc/clang) plus make. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
build_floss_tools_justification: gcc/clang and make are FLOSS. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
test_justification: 17 C test suites (normal + ASan/UBSan + Valgrind) + multi-strategy fuzzing via `bash test-c.sh`; CI runs gcc/clang, x86-32, aarch64-QEMU. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
test_invocation_justification: Run `bash test-c.sh` (normal + sanitizers + Valgrind + fuzz); documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and README. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
test_most_justification: Statement coverage is not currently measured, so 'most of the code is covered' is not asserted. The suite is substantial but this is stated honestly. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md defines when tests are required and the per-commit gate: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
tests_are_added_justification: New functionality and bug fixes are expected to ship with tests, per CONTRIBUTING.md. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the requirement to add tests with changes. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
warnings_justification: Compiler warnings addressed; build is clean with -Werror. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
warnings_fixed_justification: cppcheck and CodeQL pass in CI; warnings are fixed before merge. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
warnings_strict_justification: cppcheck and CodeQL run in CI and must pass. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia.
know_secure_design_justification: Secure design: default-deny capability gate, bounds-checked bytecode VM, DoS budgets, documented in README and SECURITY.md. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/SECURITY.md
know_common_errors_justification: Common pitfalls (memory safety, integer overflow, unbounded loops) are handled in the VM and documented in SPEC_JCB.md and SECURITY.md. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/jinvia/blob/main/SPEC_JCB.md
